title: Structural basis of serine protease inhibition by antibodies from biased Fab phage-display libraries.
authors: Anderson, Kyle J; Lee, Melody S; Sevillano, Natalia; Chen, Gang; Hornsby, Michael J; Sidhu, Sachdev S; Craik, Charles S
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合偏置Fab噬菌体展示文库与共折叠结构预测及对接，解析抗体抑制丝氨酸蛋白酶的机制，虽以抗体-蛋白酶复合物为对象，但结构预测与能量计算框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: Biased Fab phage-display libraries were designed to determine whether inhibitory CDR H3 motifs from potent anti-matriptase antibodies could be transferred to target homologous serine proteases. Using reverse-binding and substrate-like H3 motifs from parental clones A11 and E2 as templates, six synthetic libraries with 10(10) diversity were constructed. Selection against matriptase identified 16 inhibitors with sub-100 nM potency, representing 100,000-fold improvement over circularized H3 loops alone. Selection against TMPRSS2, a serine protease implicated in viral entry and prostate cancer with 43 % sequence identity to matriptase, yielded binders with micromolar inhibitory potency. Selection against urokinase plasminogen activator (uPA, 35 % identity) identified binders that adopted a substrate-like CDR H3 binding mode in our structural models. Across all reference structures, including the separately identified uPA inhibitor AB2 (PDB: 9PYF, deposited with this work), benchmarking of five co-folding methods and rigid-body docking showed that co-folding consistently achieved acceptable to high quality DockQ scores, outperforming traditional docking and capturing the recognition of key active site determinants. Ensemble predictions of mutational binding energy changes (DeltaDeltaG) using these models identified key paratope-epitope interactions, with predictions validated through mutagenesis. This work establishes a framework integrating biased antibody libraries with computational structure prediction and analysis for targeting conserved protease epitopes.
abstract_zh: 为确定强效抗matriptase抗体中的抑制性CDR H3基序能否转移至靶向同源丝氨酸蛋白酶，设计了偏倚Fab噬菌体展示文库。以亲本克隆A11和E2的反向结合及底物样H3基序为模板，构建了六个多样性为10(10)的合成文库。针对matriptase的筛选鉴定出16个效力低于100 nM的抑制剂，较环化H3环单独使用提高了100,000倍。针对TMPRSS2（一种与病毒入侵和前列腺癌相关的丝氨酸蛋白酶，与matriptase序列同一性为43%）的筛选获得了微摩尔级抑制效力的结合物。针对尿激酶型纤溶酶原激活剂（uPA，同一性35%）的筛选鉴定出在结构模型中采用底物样CDR H3结合模式的结合物。在所有参考结构中，包括单独鉴定的uPA抑制剂AB2（PDB: 9PYF，随本研究提交），五种共折叠方法和刚性对接的基准测试表明，共折叠始终达到可接受至高质量的DockQ分数，优于传统对接，并捕获了关键活性位点决定因素的识别。使用这些模型对突变结合能变化（DeltaDeltaG）的集成预测鉴定了关键的部分位-表位相互作用，并通过突变实验验证了预测。本研究建立了一个整合偏倚抗体文库与计算结构预测和分析的框架，用于靶向保守蛋白酶表位。
